propositions: Implement nested `rebar bridge` CLI group exposing only functional `preview` and `sync` verbs with read-only and mutating modes respectively.
Preview verb must force dry-run mode and perform zero Jira or ticket writes; sync verb must force live mode and persist mutations to local/binding state.
Reject `--mode`, `--filter-local-ids`, and arbitrary trailing arguments; ensure unknown nested verbs fail with valid choices and never fall through to same-named top-level commands.
Preserve legacy top-level verbs (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, doctor) unchanged; keep internal Mode, MODE_CAPS, and gated_mode round-trip intact.
Generate nested group in CLI reference and documentation; exclude internal vocabulary (mode, rank, gate, lock, cap, pass, binding store, numeric exit codes) from public help.
Real subprocess integration test against temporary git-backed tracker and production-shaped fake Jira transport must prove zero-write read path and persisted mutation preservation of unrelated state.
